comment: The LHR is described as the primary surveillance source and PHSP integration with LHR is mandatory, while the text also invokes consent. Many surveillance systems must work before LHRs exist and receive notifications directly from laboratories, facilities, communities, borders or environmental sources. Public-health processing may rely on statutory authority rather than consent, subject to safeguards.

reviewer.organisation: HISP Centre at University of Oslo

public.text: The LHR is described as the primary surveillance source and PHSP integration with LHR is mandatory, while the text also invokes consent. Many surveillance systems must work before LHRs exist and receive notifications directly from laboratories, facilities, communities, borders or environmental sources. Public-health processing may rely on statutory authority rather than consent, subject to safeguards.
public.suggestedRevision: Make LHR integration conditional on the national architecture and priority use cases, not a universal SHALL. Require PHSP to operate with direct case/event/lab/community channels. Replace blanket consent wording with lawful-basis, necessity, proportionality, minimization, transparency, access-control and oversight requirements.
